address: 21 route de la Basse-des-Feignes, La Bresse, 88250, France
bio: Perched in the hills above La Bresse at an altitude of 900m, Le Couchetat is a hotel-restaurant with all the charm of a Vosges chalet. In the kitchen, Jonathan Maugard – a native of Normandy with a wealth of experience as a chef – carefully prepares local produce, adding a welcome South American twist inspired by his partner Julie, a Chilean pastry chef: stuffed squid, pulled feather blade beef with a sweetcorn emulsion, churros with homemade dulce de leche… A more traditional set menu is also available. There are 11 guestrooms and three suites.
